in_marathi.name: Varishansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Varishansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Varishansh is a powerful and majestic name, derived from the name of Lord Vishnu, the king of gods in Hindu mythology. The name is a blend of Vaari and Ishan, which mean 'king' and 'lord of the universe', respectively.
